Metroid Prime 2 - Dark Echoes.name: Metroid Prime 2: Echoes
Metroid Prime 2 - Dark Echoes.summary: An exploration-driven 3D metroidvania/first-person shooter hybrid and sequel to Metroid Prime (2002) in which Samus lands on Aether, an intricate planet torn into light and dark versions of itself, to help its remaining inhabitants defend against the invaders from its dark incarnation by traversing both the light and dark worlds, acquiring new power-ups and braving oppressive environments.
